description: Labeled eval set for the pre-processing gate (agent/pre_processing_gate.run_gate). should_escalate=true for anger, abuse, legal or refund threats, and business-critical urgency (production outage, data loss, security incident, blocked critical business process). Neutral technical questions (even with words like error/broken/failed), mild frustration and time pressure on a how-to question should NOT escalate.
